title: Dowker's countable paracompactness, product normality and strict insertion characterization
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: Formalization of Dowker (1951), Theorem 4: normality plus ordinary countable paracompactness of an arbitrary topological space X is equivalent to normality of X times the closed unit interval, and to strict continuous insertion between arbitrary real upper and lower semicontinuous functions h<g. No T1 or Hausdorff assumption on X, boundedness or uniform gap is added. Companion compact metrizable product theorem (Lemma 3) and countable-cover/decreasing-closed-sequence equivalences (Theorem 2) are included.

review.reason: Formalizes Dowker's characterization of countable paracompactness via product normality.
